text:
Neoplastic proliferations of mature lymphocytes. The diseases involve the
blood bone marrow and other tissues. Characterized by accumulation of small
mature-looking CD5+ B lymphocytes in the blood, marrow and lymphoid
tissues. B-cell disorders are more common
B-cell CLL is more common in males than females
- Accounts for 60% of cases
- Rarely diagnosed below the age of 40 years
